A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Low-Rank Clone (LRC) research and contain 33 pages, including Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons support a complete comparison; differences are confined to first-page presentation and two bibliography entries.

before.justification: v3 reports original LRC training and benchmark results in Section 4, along with ablations, robustness tests and supplementary experimental results in Appendix E.

after.justification: v5 retains the original LRC benchmark results, ablations and supplementary experiments, including the two-seed comparison in Appendix E.8.

M1.justification: Section 3, Algorithms 1–2 and Appendix D.1 retain the same weight projections, activation cloning, training losses and trainable parameters. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: The training datasets and evaluation coverage are unchanged, including the general language benchmarks and the safety, honesty and instruction-following tasks documented in Appendices D–E.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and appendix experiments. Both retain comparisons with Sheared-Llama, Minitron, TinyBERT and the same public SLM checkpoints.

E3.justification: Both retain the same training budgets, model configurations, sequence lengths, evaluation metrics and testing procedures. Section 4.1, Appendix D and the five-shot protocol associated with Table 17 are unchanged.

E4.justification: The component and layer ablations, data-quality analysis, neuron masking, pruning, quantization, loss-weight sensitivity and projection-structure analyses are identical in Sections 4.3–4.5 and Appendix E.

E5.justification: Appendix E.8 and Table 20 already report runs with seeds 218 and 42 in v3 and remain identical in v5. The qualification about limited repeated runs and plans for further mean/variance reporting is also unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results, rankings and plotted trends are unchanged throughout. For example, Table 1 retains LRC-1.7B's average of 64.98, and Table 20 retains LRC-1.5B's two-seed averages of 63.48 and 63.30. Figure 1 retains the same plotted content.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations in Section 3, Lemma 1 and its Appendix A proof, and the Johnson–Lindenstrauss scalability argument in Appendix B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and efficiency claims, including unified soft pruning and distillation, FFN activation transfer and competitive performance using over 1,000 times fewer training tokens.

C2.justification: The FFN knowledge-transfer interpretation, limitations concerning larger training budgets and retained FFN dimensions, and appendix discussions of SFT, few-shot behavior and stability are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix D retains identical implementation details, checkpoint identifiers, hyperparameters, hardware, training times and dataset information. Code and model access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain unchanged. References 26 and 27 still identify MEFT and OmniKV respectively; their edits concern capitalization and publication metadata rather than adding or removing research.

P1.justification: Reference 26 replaces MEFT's ACL proceedings details with an arXiv preprint citation; reference 27 drops OmniKV's venue abbreviation and year. Both titles receive capitalization edits, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. The scientific prose and document structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 and its caption move upward on page 1, resolving the caption's overlap with the introduction text in v3. The figure content and other figures and tables are unchanged; bibliography wrapping and the version stamp also receive localized layout changes.

improvement.justification: v5 fixes a visible collision between Figure 1's caption and the introduction, providing a small, concrete readability improvement. References 26–27 lose some publication detail, but this limited drawback does not outweigh the layout repair. The scientific content and appendices remain unchanged.
